say:1:1231157001:1.text: You'd have to ask Bruce, I'm not exactly sure what he's writing.
say:1:1231157001:1.source_cn: 那你得问布鲁，我也不知道他在写什么。

say:2:1231157002:1.text: He's always after really specific details, like the proper way to tie a sailor's knot, or what to use to polish the deck.
say:2:1231157002:1.source_cn: 他总问我非常细节的问题，比如水手结怎么系，甲板用什么抛...

say:3:1231157003:1.text: Will knowing all this stuff help him write a good novel? I guess I just don't get it.
say:3:1231157003:1.source_cn: 这些常识真的能帮他写出好小说来吗？我搞不懂。

say:4:1231157004:1.text: Still, it's nice to have someone around who admires your work!
say:4:1231157004:1.source_cn: 不过，有人一直用憧憬的眼光看着自己，这感觉很不错！
